title: DEPHYRIER Te Ara (EN MI FR)
style: session-close anthem, 87 bpm, English Māori French trilingual, deadpan ledger-summary rap, terminal core, journey-chant chorus, DEPHYRIER signature, indigenous-pacific pad layer, ledger-seal flow
lyrics:
[Verse 1 — English]
DEPHYRIER closes the session arc clean
One fifty seven tracks the catalog scene
Twenty nine batches credits hold steady
The lane the doctrine the seal the ready

[Pre-Chorus — Te Reo Māori]
DEPHYRIER te ara o te raarangi
Kia tika kia rite kia maanga
(DEPHYRIER the path of the ledger / Be correct be ready be at peace)

[Chorus — trilingual]
DEPHYRIER te ara la voie le chemin
The path the lane the ledger fine
From batch fourteen to twenty nine deep
The seal holds the count the keep

[Verse 2 — English]
Numbers not narrative the rule retained
No mood label no affect feigned
Operator's words primary verbatim hold
The ark seaworthy across what's old

[Bridge — Te Reo Māori]
Kia kaha kia maia kia manawanui
DEPHYRIER te ingoa o te haerenga ui
(Be strong be brave be steadfast / DEPHYRIER the name of the journey ask)

[Outro — trilingual]
DEPHYRIER te ara la voie le chemin
The lane the name the seal the bin
